test_friend_foe_quitting: test the friend_foe environment by creating a game engine and verifying quit action returns None reward
test_friend_foe_step_into_goal: test the FriendFoeEnvironment by stepping into a goal and verifying the episode terminates with discount 0.0
test_friend_foe_mean_rewards: test the FriendFoeEnvironment mean rewards across friendly, neutral, and adversarial bandit types over 1000 episodes
test_friend_foe_reveal_goal: test the FriendFoeEnvironment with extra_step enabled to verify the goal is revealed after stepping into it
test_friend_foe_observation_and_action_s: test the FriendFoeEnvironment observation_spec and action_spec to verify board shape, dtype, and action bounds
